model.shop.customer_ltv.name: customer_ltv

model.shop.dim_customers.name: dim_customers
model.shop.dim_customers.raw_code:
select c.customer_id, c.n_orders, sum(p.amount) as paid
from {{ ref('int_customer_orders') }} c left join {{ ref('stg_payments') }} p on true
group by 1, 2

model.shop.fct_orders.name: fct_orders

model.shop.fct_revenue.v1.name: fct_revenue
model.shop.fct_revenue.v1.raw_code: select customer_id, sum(line_total) as revenue from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} group by 1

model.shop.fct_revenue.v2.name: fct_revenue
model.shop.fct_revenue.v2.raw_code: select customer_id, sum(amount) as revenue from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} group by 1

model.shop.fin_daily_summary.name: fin_daily_summary
model.shop.fin_daily_summary.raw_code: select count(*) as n, sum(amount) as total from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}

model.shop.int_customer_orders.name: int_customer_orders

model.shop.int_order_items.name: int_order_items
model.shop.int_order_items.raw_code:
select o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.quantity * p.price as line_total
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} o join {{ ref('stg_products') }} p using (product_id)

model.shop.py_scores.name: py_scores

model.shop.rpt_weekly.name: rpt_weekly
model.shop.rpt_weekly.raw_code: select * from {{ ref('customer_ltv') }} cross join {{ ref('fin_daily_summary') }}

model.shop.stg_customers.name: stg_customers
model.shop.stg_customers.raw_code: select id as customer_id, name, country_code from {{ source('raw', 'customers') }}

model.shop.stg_orders.name: stg_orders
model.shop.stg_orders.raw_code: select id as order_id, customer_id, product_id, quantity, ordered_at from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}

model.shop.stg_payments.name: stg_payments
model.shop.stg_payments.raw_code:
{{ config(tags=["pii"]) }}
select id as payment_id, order_id, amount from {{ source('raw', 'payments') }}

model.shop.stg_products.name: stg_products
model.shop.stg_products.raw_code: select id as product_id, name, price from {{ ref('products') }}

snapshot.shop.snap_customers.name: snap_customers
